spec.assertion: Proves the line is board-inert (removing skill1 leaves every unit's total byte-identical) and that it was not transcribed 1:1 into damageTakenPct/attackDamagePct 6.94. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'DEF down == Damage Taken up' fold, which would lift the whole team ~6.9%. The real DEF reduction is it.skip'd: StatKey has no enemy-DEF channel, resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) is empty, and boss DEF is a fixed constant.

Trigger identity is untestable while the payload has no engine channel — an SR's every pull is a full charge, so shotFired is the correct carrier, but nothing observable distinguishes it from any other trigger when the effect emits no event and moves no damage. Recorded, not asserted.

Asserts a raw-percentage atkPct buffApply of exactly 10.98 exists (fails under a casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct encoding, which re-emits as a large flat ATK number) and that the window is time-bound (durationShots undefined, expiresFrame finite) — fails under a round-count encoding and under an always-on passive with no expiry.

spec.kitLine: Affects all allies with sniper rifles
spec.assertion: Asserts the ATK and ammo buffs reach himeno (self-inclusive; no 'except self') and the SR teammate helm, and NEVER the non-SR B1 ally liter. Fails under the nearest-wrong target {kind:'allies'} — and the counterfactual run proves the check is non-vacuous by showing liter IS reached and IS lifted under that wrong scope.

spec.kitLine: Max Ammo up 2 round(s) for 10 sec
spec.assertion: Asserts maxAmmoFlat 2 exists, carries the sniper-only scope, and is damage-bearing (himeno's total strictly exceeds the value-zeroed run — +2 on a 6-round magazine removes reloads). The flat-vs-percent discriminator re-stats the same 2 as maxAmmoPct: 2% of 6 rounds is 0.12, so the wrong encoding must score strictly lower.

Asserts exactly one distinct recipient across the fight and one application per cast per stat, and that the recipient is not the B1 supporter. Fails under target {kind:'allies'} (or any count>1), which the counterfactual run shows emits strictly more applications.

Asserts stat chargeDamagePct at 23.76 with a finite expiry and no durationShots, and that no chargeDamageMultPct 23.76 exists — fails under the nearest-wrong 'Charge Damage Multiplier' reading, which scales by BASE charge damage instead of adding percentage points.

Asserts generic critRatePct 16.35 and the absence of critRateNormalPct 16.35 — the kit says plain 'Critical Rate', so the normal-attack-scoped stat would starve the recipient's skill/burst crit. Plus a damage-movement check (zeroing both riders lowers the recipient) and an inertness check (every non-recipient byte-identical).

fixtures: controlComp('himeno', true) — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / himeno (carry) / helm (fixed B3). fixedB3 is kept TRUE deliberately: the fixed slot is an SR/Water unit, so the comp contains both an SR teammate (helm) and a non-SR teammate (liter), which is the only way skill2's 'allies with sniper rifles' target set is discriminable rather than vacuous. himeno is Burst II, so liter/crown supply the burst chain and she actually casts (a lone caster makes zero full bursts). 7 hoisted runs: control, skill1-cleared, ammo-zeroed, ammo-as-percent, skill2-target-all-allies, burst-target-all-allies, burst-riders-zeroed. No seed (deterministic).
gaps: skill1 DEF down 6.94% for 3 sec — it.skip: no engine primitive for enemy DEF reduction. StatKey carries no enemy-DEF channel (defPct is documented as self-DEF and inert in v1), resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [], and the scope-lock boss DEF is a fixed constant. Enacting needs both an engine channel and the boss DEF value; the line is recorded-inert today and the tests pin that it does not become a Damage-Taken fudge.

skill2 trigger cadence — it.skip FLAG: the kit prose gives NO activation clause for the two 10-second buffs, so the fire period is outside the input domain (it comes from datamined skillCooldownsSec, not the kit text). Asserting a specific trigger kind or period would be inventing an input; only the target set, stat identity, magnitudes and duration semantics are kit-derivable and therefore asserted.
skill1 trigger identity (full-charge hit) — not asserted: with no observable payload there is nothing to discriminate a shotFired carrier from any other trigger.
